_note: State overrides. Every constant not listed here is taken from data/constants.json unchanged: hot water demand, efficiencies, COP, installed costs (DCCEEW RIS Table 20 is national), rebate (0) and deal parameters. The efficiencies are the NSW climate zone (Zone 3) values; they have not been adjusted for this state's climate.
name: the ACT

EF_electricity_kgCO2e_per_kWh.source: DCCEEW, 'Australian National Greenhouse Accounts Factors 2026', Table 1, 'New South Wales and Australian Capital Territory': scope 2 = 0.6, scope 3 = 0.07.
EF_electricity_kgCO2e_per_kWh.check: Read from the official XLSX (archived copy, captured 2026-09-10, text dump in data/source_text/national-greenhouse-accounts-factors-2026.xlsx.txt).

EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.source: DCCEEW, 'Australian National Greenhouse Accounts Factors 2026'. Table 5, 'Natural gas distributed in a pipeline', scope 1 combined gases = 51.53 kg CO2-e/GJ. Table 6, 'New South Wales and ACT', Metro, scope 3 = 13.1 kg CO2-e/GJ.
EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.check: Read from the official XLSX (archived copy, captured 2026-09-10, text dump in data/source_text/national-greenhouse-accounts-factors-2026.xlsx.txt).
EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.note: UNIT TRAP: per MJ, not per GJ.

tariffs.electricityPlan: ActewAGL Home time-of-use with controlled load (standing offer)
tariffs.gasPlan: ActewAGL Home Gas plan - ACT region (standing offer)
tariffs.timeOfUse: Three rates: peak $0.452/kWh 07:00 to 08:59 and 17:00 to 19:59, off-peak $0.272/kWh 22:00 to 06:59, shoulder $0.305146/kWh otherwise. At 03:00 the off-peak rate applies.
tariffs.retailer: ActewAGL is the ACT's incumbent retailer; AGL does not offer an ACT standing offer in the CDR data.
tariffs.source: AER Consumer Data Right, Energy Product Reference Data API, postcode 2600. Raw responses in data/cdr_raw/act/ (scripts/fetch_cdr_states.py).
tariffs.heatPumpRate: The heat pump is priced at the rate in force at 03:00 on a weekday, the overnight window a timer targets, as in NSW and Victoria (src/lib/cdr.ts).
tariffs.gst: CDR unit prices are stored the same way for every state, so all states are on the same basis.
